name: Customer History Report
query:
SELECT 
    si.customer,
    sii.item_code,
    sii.qty,
    sii.rate,
    sii.amount,
    si.posting_date,
    si.status
FROM 
    `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN 
    `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON si.name = sii.parent
ORDER BY 
    si.posting_date DESC
